summary: Acquisition hire bulk onboarding: staged SSO groups, asset transfer, and 90-day privileged access request
description:
Issue summary: We need to onboard a batch of 18 employees transferred from AcmeAI (acquisition close on 2026-03-01). The group will be split into two waves (12 then 6) over the next three weeks to avoid bottlenecks.

Impact: These are product and infra engineers that require access to internal repos, dedicated service accounts for migration work, VPN/VPC access, and temporary elevated privileges to perform a one-time migration of model checkpoints and namespace resources. Failure to stage access will block the migration work and delay integration milestones.

Requirements: 1) Create Okta users with SCIM sync and assign to two pre-created groups (acq-wave-1, acq-wave-2). 2) Provision company laptops for 12 immediate hires from the shared acquisition asset pool and ship to listed home addresses. 3) Issue temporary sudo and K8s cluster edit role for a 90-day window for 8 engineers (knowledge transfer), with monthly review reminders. 4) Migrate/transfer ownership of 3 service accounts and rotate KMS access keys after transfer. 5) Tag assets, record serials in Asset Management, and attach custodian notes.

Constraints: VPN onboarding requires new onboarding subnet approval from Networking (ticket NET-5463 referenced in comments). Asset pool is limited: 8 developer laptops on hand; remaining devices will be shipped from vendor and require vendor tracking. Security wants just-in-time approval for elevated access and audit trail in CloudTrail and internal logs.

Deliverables/Acceptance criteria: - All Wave 1 users active in Okta and in Slack by 2026-03-15. - Laptops shipped with MDM enrolled and serials logged before handoff. - 90-day elevated role created and timeboxed; automated deactivation scheduled. - Service-account ownership transfer completed and KMS keys rotated; PRs and audit logs linked in ticket.
tasks: Create 18 Okta accounts using SCIM; add attributes from HR CSV (HR provided on 2026-03-10)
Map each hire to departmental groups and grant initial repo access (github teams: infra-acq, ml-acq)
Prepare and ship 12 laptops from: 6 MacBook Pros (16GB/512GB), 4 Linux ThinkPads (32GB/1TB), 2 loaner dev kits; enroll in MDM and label asset tags
Provision 3 migration service accounts, update IAM principals, and plan KMS key rotation post-transfer
Create timeboxed sudo and Kubernetes edit role for 8 engineers with 90-day TTL; add monthly reminder to review in Calendar
Coordinate networking subnet approval with Networking team (see NET-5463) for VPN onboarding
Log all serial numbers and custodian assignments in Asset Management; create transfer tickets for vendor-fulfilled devices
Add wave announcement to #new-hires and #support for onboarding schedule and buddy assignments
